title: Valid login
steps: Open the login page, enter Voter ID TEST-0001 and the correct password, submit.
expected: Logged in; the 'Choose a voting event' page (/events) is shown.
actual: HTTP 200, landed on /events, 'Choose a voting event' shown: True

title: Wrong password
steps: Login with Voter ID TEST-0002 and a wrong password; then open /events.
expected: Error message shown; not logged in (/events sends back to the login page).
actual: HTTP 200, stayed on /, error shown: True; /events -> /?next=/events (login form shown: True)

title: Unregistered Voter ID
steps: Login with Voter ID TEST-9999 (no such account) and any password; open /events.
expected: Error message shown; not logged in.
actual: HTTP 200, error shown: True; /events -> /?next=/events (login form shown: True)

title: Unapproved student (auto-approve OFF)
steps: TEST-0004 logs in, taps Register on 'TEST Approval Election' (auto-approve OFF), then opens its ballot and also tries RPC cast_vote.
expected: Registration is PENDING; ballot not available ('pending approval' message); vote refused and not saved.
actual: register -> 'PENDING' message: True, DB status: pending; ballot -> /events#current with 'pending approval': True; RPC cast_vote -> error -32015 'Your registration for this event is still pending approval.'; ballots saved: 0

title: Cast a vote
steps: TEST-0005 logs in, opens the ballot of 'TEST Main Election', submits the ballot form (President, Vice President, 2 Councilors).
expected: Vote saved in the database (1 ballot, 4 vote rows); the receipt page is shown.
actual: HTTP 200, landed on /e/1/receipt, receipt shown: True, receipt code 5801B894; DB: 1 ballot, 4 vote rows

title: Duplicate vote in the same event
steps: TEST-0005 (already voted in TC-05) submits the ballot form again, then tries RPC cast_vote too.
expected: Both rejected ('already voted'); still exactly 1 ballot and 4 vote rows in the database.
actual: form -> /e/1/receipt, 'already voted' shown: True; RPC -> error -32011 'You have already voted.'; DB: 1 ballot, 4 vote rows

title: Vote in an upcoming or closed event
steps: TEST-0007 (registered in 'TEST Upcoming Election' and 'TEST Closed Election') opens both ballots and tries to vote in both (ballot form + RPC cast_vote).
expected: No ballot (no candidates to choose) for either event; every vote attempt refused; nothing saved.
actual: upcoming: ballot page has candidates: False; form vote -> /e/3/ballot; RPC -> error -32016 'Voting has not started yet for this event. Your ballot was not recorded.'; saved: 0 | closed: ballot page has candidates: False; form vote -> /e/4/ballot; RPC -> error -32010 'Voting is closed for this event. Your ballot was not recorded.'; saved: 0

title: More candidates than allowed
steps: TEST-0008 submits the ballot with 4 Councilors (the position allows up to 3): ballot form and RPC cast_vote.
expected: Blocked with 'Too many candidates' message; nothing saved.
actual: form -> /e/1/ballot, 'Too many candidates chosen for one position (at most 3)' shown: True; RPC -> error -32012 'Too many candidates chosen for one position (at most 3).'; ballots saved: 0

title: Expired / invalid session submits a vote
steps: (a) a browser with a forged session cookie submits the ballot form; (b) TEST-0009 logs in, then the session is invalidated on the server (password changed elsewhere: session_version + 1) and the open ballot is submitted; (c) RPC cast_vote without a session.
expected: Each time: sent to the login page / 'not logged in'; no vote saved.
actual: (a) forged cookie -> /?next=/e/1/vote, login form: True; (b) expired session -> /, login form + 'logged out' message: True; (c) RPC -> error -32001 'Please log in first.'; ballots saved: TEST-0009 0, student #1 0

title: Receipt download PNG and JPG
steps: TEST-0005 (voted in TC-05) downloads /receipt/<code>.png and .jpg.
expected: HTTP 200, valid PNG and JPEG images (open with an image library), about 1080 px wide.
actual: png: HTTP 200, image/png, PNG 1080x2076, 200235 bytes, file name "BotoKo-receipt-TEST-Main-Election-5801B894.png" | jpg: HTTP 200, image/jpeg, JPEG 1080x2076, 286570 bytes, file name "BotoKo-receipt-TEST-Main-Election-5801B894.jpg"

title: Live results update after a vote from a second client
steps: Client A (TEST-0011) reads the live results (RPC get_results); client B (TEST-0012, separate session) votes; A reads the results again after 2 s.
expected: A's second reading shows 1 more ballot and +1 vote for the candidate B chose.
actual: B's vote: recorded, receipt 4CB53415; A before: 1 ballots, candidate 0 votes; A after: 2 ballots, candidate 1 votes

title: Admin login
steps: On the same login page, enter Voter ID 'admin' and the (test) admin password.
expected: The COMELEC admin dashboard (/admin) is shown.
actual: HTTP 200, landed on /admin, dashboard shown: True

title: 100 simultaneous votes
steps: 100 different students (TEST-0101..TEST-0200) log in first; then all 100 send RPC cast_vote at the same instant (100 client threads released together). Then the database is queried.
expected: All 100 votes accepted; exactly 100 ballots, 0 duplicates, every candidate's count = what was sent.
actual: logins ok 100/100; accepted 100/100 in 0.70 s, errors 0; DB: 100 ballots (0 duplicates), event total 2 -> 102; tally matches what was sent: True (387/387 vote rows); handled by 4 worker processes

title: Server unavailable
steps: TEST-0014 logs in (has a session + token); the server is stopped; the client sends RPC cast_vote; the database is checked.
expected: The request fails (connection refused); no vote recorded.
actual: server stopped; request failed: ConnectionError; TEST-0014 ballots: 0; total ballots 165 -> 165

title: Admin pending list shows a newly registered student automatically (no refresh)
steps: Admin opens the Accounts tab, filters 'Pending' and searches 'tc15'. A NEW student creates an account; another new student (name not matching the search) too. Then a verified student registers for the approval-required event (Registrations tab). Finally the first new account is approved from ANOTHER admin session.
expected: Within a few seconds the new student's row (Approve / Reject) appears by itself, the page is not reloaded, the filter/search stay (the non-matching row is hidden), no duplicate rows; the new registration row appears too; the row approved elsewhere disappears from the pending list.
actual: account row appeared after 2.4 s (badge 0 -> 2), Approve/Reject buttons: True; non-matching new row present but hidden by the search: True; no duplicates after 2 more polls: True; filter + search kept: True; page not reloaded: True; registration row appeared after 2.3 s; approved in another admin session -> row removed after 3.4 s

title: Waiting student is redirected to events automatically after approval (no click)
steps: A new student creates an account and logs in on a phone-size screen: the 'waiting for verification' page. The admin verifies the account (from the admin side). Nothing is clicked on the student's screen. A second waiting student (desktop) is rejected with a reason.
expected: Within a few seconds the student sees 'You're approved!' and is taken to the events page by itself; the rejected student sees the rejection reason by itself.
actual: phone: waiting page shown: True; after approval 'You're approved!' after 4.4 s and the events page ('Choose a voting event': True) after 5.6 s, without any click; desktop: rejection reason shown after 4.4 s without any click

title: Admin ends voting early; ballot closes and new votes are rejected
steps: 'TEST End-Early Election' is open (ends in 3 days, auto-publish OFF). TEST-0021 votes. The admin opens the event page, clicks 'End voting now' and confirms. Then TEST-0022 opens the ballot and tries to vote (form + RPC).
expected: Confirmation 'End voting now? Students will no longer be able to vote. This cannot be undone.'; the event becomes Previous/closed with the end time = now, the action is logged (who + when), no reopen button; the ballot has no candidates; the vote is rejected with a clear message; TEST-0021's vote is still counted.
actual: button 'End voting now' -> confirmation 'End voting now? Students will no longer be able to vote. This cannot be undone.'; DB: manual=closed, end time set to now: True; server log line 'VOTING ENDED by admin ... for event 5': True; admin page shows 'Voting has ended': True, reopen button: False; ballot has candidates: False; form vote -> message shown: True; RPC -> error -32010 'Voting is closed for this event. Your ballot was not recorded.'; TEST-0021 voted before: True; ballots in the event: 1

title: Vote submitted after admin ended voting is rejected; no duplicate or partial ballots
steps: 60 students of 'TEST Race Election' log in; all 60 send their vote at the same instant and, while the votes are being saved, the admin ends voting (RPC close_voting). Afterwards 5 of the rejected students try again.
expected: Every vote is either fully counted or cleanly rejected ('Voting is closed'); ballots stored = votes accepted, 0 duplicates, every stored ballot has all its vote rows; every vote sent after the close is rejected.
actual: close_voting answered ok when 59 of 60 votes had been sent; accepted 52, rejected 8 (all with -32010 'Voting is closed': True); DB: 52 ballots, 0 duplicates, has_voted flags 52, every stored ballot complete: True; 5 votes sent after the close -> all rejected: True; ballots still 52

title: Winners appear after ending voting according to the auto-publish setting
steps: (A) 'TEST Auto-Publish Election' (auto-publish ON): 10 students vote; a student keeps its live results page open; the admin ends voting. (B) 'TEST End-Early Election' (auto-publish OFF, ended in TC-17): a student opens its results page; then the admin clicks 'Publish official results'.
expected: (A) right after ending: results official, the open page shows the winners by itself (no reload by the student). (B) before publishing: no numbers ('announced soon'), RPC refuses (-32021); after publishing the open page shows the winners by itself within a few seconds.
actual: (A) 10 votes cast; auto-publish ON: open live page showed the winners 1.9 s after the admin ended voting (no reload by the student); RPC get_results: final=True, 5 winner marks. (B) auto-publish OFF: before publishing RPC -> error -32021, page shows 'announced soon' without numbers: True; after 'Publish official results' (HTTP 200) the open page showed the winners after 3.5 s; RPC now final=True

title: Admin dashboard can switch between multiple events and shows the correct results for each
steps: Admin logs in (dashboard). The 'Results by event' selector lists all events with their status. The admin switches to a finished event, an upcoming event and the main open event; then presses Back and reloads. Also checked on a phone-size screen.
expected: Default = an open event; every switch updates the results/turnout without a full reload and shows that event's own numbers (= database); the upcoming event shows 'Voting has not started yet'; the URL keeps ?results=<id> (Back and refresh keep it); live updates follow only the selected event; the Parallel processing panel is not duplicated; no sideways scroll on a phone.
actual: selector lists 7 of 7 events, each labelled with its status: True; default selection: event 1 (current); e17: switched + correct: True (votes cast shown 1 = database 1), in URL: True; upcoming: switched + correct: True (empty state 'Voting has not started yet'), in URL: True; main: switched + correct: True (votes cast shown 102 = database 102), in URL: True; no full page reload: True; live updates only for the selected event: True (2 calls in 5 s); Back -> previous selection: True; refresh keeps it: True; Parallel processing panel only in the Results tab: True; phone 390 px: selector visible, no sideways scroll: True
